title: Ludo at the Table
description: Playing Ludo well and playing it online: rules disputes, house rules, tournaments and nights with family far away. Notes by Ahmed Moaz.
blurb: Notes on playing Ludo with real people: which rules to settle before the first throw, how to run a family Ludo night across two cities, and what changes when the board is on a screen instead of a table.
about: I am Ahmed Moaz. I build Boardit, a small site of free browser games that includes Ludo.

This blog is about Ludo as people actually play it: rules arguments, house rules, family nights and playing online with friends. Where a claim depends on how one particular version works, the note says so.
